summary.en: Conan, Ran and Kogoro are walking in the city, with Kogoro and Ran talking about Kogoro upcoming reunion of his university Judo club at a hot spring. Ran wants to go because she went to one five years ago, while Kogoro wants Ran to stay so that the office will not be closed, despite the fact that it will be closed while Kogoro is on vacation. To convince Kogoro, Ran asks if Conan wants to come as well. To prevent Ran from going to the reunion, Kogoro tells them that he was going to treat her to a fancy meal instead, but Ran passes the meal for the hot spring instead. Kogoro then tells Ran that domestic flights are a lot more expensive than international ones, accidentally revealing that he does not want to pay at all. Kogoro and Conan chased the robber into an alley. When the robber prepared to shoot, Conan used his kicking shoes, and kicked a brick at the robber, knocking his gun out of his hand, which allowed Kogoro to tackle the robber. However the gun quickly disappeared from the crime scene. When Conan asked Kogoro how Yumi killed herself, Kogoro responded by saying that Yumi put the gun to her head, he then stops when he realizes something is wrong. Going back to Yumi’s body with Kazushi, they both see the gunshot wound again in which they look more closely at, and see that there are no burn marks at all on the wound. Meaning Yumi did not commit suicide, instead someone killed her and made it look like it was suicide.
